prompt: The new vaccine proved highly ---- in clinical trials, reducing infection rates by nearly 90 percent.
explanation: Efficacious = etkili. Enfeksiyonu %90 azaltan bir aşı için olumlu ve etki bildiren tek sıfat bu. Ambiguous (belirsiz), redundant (gereksiz), obsolete (modası geçmiş) anlamı bozar.

prompt: Despite years of research, scientists have not yet been able to ---- the exact cause of the disease.
explanation: Pinpoint = tam olarak tespit etmek. 'Kesin nedeni' ifadesiyle birlikte kullanılır. Undermine (zayıflatmak) ve postpone (ertelemek) bağlama uymaz.

prompt: The committee decided to ---- the meeting until all members could attend.
explanation: Put off = ertelemek. 'Herkes katılana kadar' ifadesi zamanı ileri atmayı gösterir. Turn down reddetmek, look into incelemek demektir.

prompt: The economist argued that the government's policies would only ---- the gap between the rich and the poor.
explanation: Exacerbate = kötüleştirmek, derinleştirmek. 'Only' vurgusu eleştirel bir ton verir; alleviate (hafifletmek) tam tersi anlamdadır ve tuzak şıktır.

prompt: Many species are now ---- to extinction because their natural habitats are disappearing.
explanation: Vulnerable to = -e karşı savunmasız. Immune to (bağışık) zıt anlamlı tuzaktır; accustomed to (alışkın) bağlama uymaz.

prompt: Our flight was delayed, so we had to ---- a hotel near the airport for the night.
explanation: Check into a hotel = otele giriş yapmak. Run out of (tükenmek), get over (atlatmak), set off (yola çıkmak) cümleye uymaz.

prompt: By the time the rescue team arrived, the fire ---- most of the building.
explanation: 'By the time + geçmiş zaman' yapısında daha önce tamamlanmış eylem past perfect (had + V3) ile anlatılır.

prompt: ---- the heavy rain, the match went ahead as planned.
explanation: Boşluktan sonra isim (the heavy rain) geliyor; zıtlık bildiren edat 'despite' gerekir. 'Although' cümle ister, 'because of' zıtlık değil neden bildirir.

prompt: If the researchers ---- more funding, they could have completed the project on time.
explanation: Ana cümlede 'could have completed' var: geçmişe dönük gerçek dışı koşul (Type 3). Yan cümlede past perfect kullanılır.

prompt: The report, ---- was published last week, has caused a lot of controversy.
explanation: Virgülle ayrılmış (non-defining) sıfat cümlesinde 'that' kullanılamaz; nesneyi niteleyen 'which' doğrudur.

prompt: Not only ---- the deadline, but he also forgot to inform his manager.
explanation: 'Not only' cümle başında olduğunda devrik yapı gelir: yardımcı fiil + özne + fiil (did he miss).

prompt: The more you practise speaking, ---- you will become.
explanation: 'The more ..., the more ...' kalıbı: bir şey arttıkça diğeri de artar. İkinci yarı da 'the + comparative' ile kurulur.

passage: Sleep is not simply a period of rest. While we sleep, the brain actively processes the information it (1) ---- during the day. Researchers have found that people who sleep well after learning a new skill perform better the next day (2) ---- those who stay awake.
prompt: (1) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelir?
explanation: 'During the day' şimdiye kadar biriken bilgiyi anlatır; genel doğruyu anlatan metinde present perfect (has gathered) en uygun zamandır.

passage: Sleep is not simply a period of rest. While we sleep, the brain actively processes the information it (1) ---- during the day. Researchers have found that people who sleep well after learning a new skill perform better the next day (2) ---- those who stay awake.
prompt: (2) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelir?
explanation: 'Better' karşılaştırma sıfatıdır ve 'than' ile tamamlanır.

passage: Urban gardens are becoming increasingly popular in large cities. (1) ---- providing fresh produce, they also help reduce air pollution and create green spaces where neighbours can meet. However, their success largely depends (2) ---- the support of local authorities.
prompt: (1) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelir?
explanation: Cümle ek fayda sayıyor (also help...). 'In addition to + V-ing' = -e ek olarak. Instead of (yerine) ve in spite of (rağmen) anlamı bozar.

passage: Urban gardens are becoming increasingly popular in large cities. (1) ---- providing fresh produce, they also help reduce air pollution and create green spaces where neighbours can meet. However, their success largely depends (2) ---- the support of local authorities.
prompt: (2) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelir?
explanation: 'Depend on' sabit bir fiil-edat kalıbıdır: -e bağlı olmak.

prompt: Although electric cars are becoming cheaper, ----.
options: many people are still worried about the limited number of charging stations
they produce no exhaust emissions at all
governments are offering tax reductions to buyers
their batteries have improved considerably in recent years
more models are available than ever before
explanation: 'Although' zıtlık ister: arabalar ucuzluyor AMA insanlar hâlâ endişeli. Diğer şıklar elektrikli araçların lehine olup zıtlık kurmaz.

prompt: Unless the city invests in public transport, ----.
options: traffic congestion will continue to get worse
more people have started cycling to work
the new metro line was opened last year
buses were cheaper in the past
residents voted for a new mayor
explanation: 'Unless' (-mezse) koşul bildirir; ana cümle gelecek zamanlı bir sonuç ister: 'will continue'. Diğer şıklar zaman ve anlamca uymaz.

prompt: So complex was the problem that ----.
options: even the most experienced engineers needed weeks to solve it
it was solved in a few minutes by a student
the engineers found it quite simple
nobody had ever heard of it before
the company decided to hire more staff last year
explanation: 'So ... that' sonuç bildirir: sorun o kadar karmaşıktı ki en deneyimli mühendisler bile haftalarca uğraştı. Diğer şıklar karmaşıklığın doğal sonucu değildir.

prompt: ----, the museum attracts thousands of visitors every summer.
options: Located in the heart of the old town
Although it is difficult to reach
Since it was closed for repairs
explanation: Kısaltılmış sıfat cümlesi (Located in...) müzeyi niteleyip ziyaretçi çekmesinin nedenini verir. 'Although/even though' zıtlık kurar ama cümlede zıtlık yok.

prompt: Scientists believe that regular exercise can significantly reduce the risk of heart disease.
options: Bilim insanları düzenli egzersizin kalp hastalığı riskini önemli ölçüde azaltabileceğine inanıyor.
Bilim insanları kalp hastalığının düzenli egzersizle tamamen önlenebildiğini kanıtladı.
Düzenli egzersiz yapan bilim insanlarının kalp hastalığı riski oldukça düşüktür.
Bilim insanlarına göre kalp hastaları düzenli olarak egzersiz yapmalıdır.
Kalp hastalığı riskini azaltmak için bilim insanları düzenli egzersiz öneriyor.
explanation: 'Believe that' = inanıyor, 'can significantly reduce' = önemli ölçüde azaltabilir. B şıkkı 'kanıtladı' ve 'tamamen' diyerek anlamı abartıyor; E şıkkı 'öneriyor' diyerek fiili değiştiriyor.

prompt: Türkiye'nin en kalabalık şehri olan İstanbul, iki kıta üzerinde kurulmuştur.
options: Istanbul, which is the most populous city in Turkey, is built on two continents.
Istanbul is one of the most crowded cities built between two continents.
Turkey's biggest city Istanbul was once built on two different continents.
Being built on two continents, Istanbul became Turkey's largest city.
The population of Istanbul, a city on two continents, is the highest in the world.
explanation: Ara söz 'Türkiye'nin en kalabalık şehri olan' bir sıfat cümlesiyle (which is the most populous city in Turkey) çevrilir. D şıkkı neden sonuç ilişkisi ekliyor, E şıkkı 'dünyada' diyerek anlamı değiştiriyor.

prompt: Had the data been analysed more carefully, the researchers would have noticed the error much earlier.
options: Veriler daha dikkatli analiz edilseydi, araştırmacılar hatayı çok daha önce fark ederdi.
Araştırmacılar verileri dikkatlice analiz ettikleri için hatayı erkenden fark etti.
Veriler analiz edildiğinde araştırmacılar hatanın çok eski olduğunu fark etti.
Araştırmacıların hatayı fark etmesi için verilerin dikkatle analiz edilmesi gerekiyor.
Veriler daha dikkatli analiz edilirse, araştırmacılar hatayı daha önce fark edecek.
explanation: 'Had the data been analysed' devrik Type 3 koşuldur: geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş durum (edilseydi ... ederdi). B şıkkı olmuş bir olayı anlatıyor, E şıkkı gelecek zaman kullanıyor.

passage: Bees play a vital role in agriculture. Around one third of the food we eat depends on pollination, and bees are responsible for most of it. In recent decades, however, bee populations have declined sharply in many parts of the world. Scientists point to several causes, including pesticide use, habitat loss and climate change. Some farmers have responded by planting wildflowers along the edges of their fields, which provide food and shelter for bees throughout the year.
prompt: According to the passage, why do some farmers plant wildflowers?
options: To support bee populations by giving them food and shelter
To reduce their use of pesticides
To attract tourists to their farms
To increase the price of their crops
To replace crops that depend on pollination
explanation: Son cümle cevabı açıkça veriyor: kır çiçekleri arılara yıl boyunca 'food and shelter' sağlar. Pestisit metinde neden olarak geçiyor, çözüm olarak değil.

passage: Bees play a vital role in agriculture. Around one third of the food we eat depends on pollination, and bees are responsible for most of it. In recent decades, however, bee populations have declined sharply in many parts of the world. Scientists point to several causes, including pesticide use, habitat loss and climate change. Some farmers have responded by planting wildflowers along the edges of their fields, which provide food and shelter for bees throughout the year.
prompt: The word 'declined' in the passage is closest in meaning to ----.
explanation: Decline = azalmak (decrease). 'Sharply' ile birlikte keskin bir düşüşü anlatır. Recovered ve multiplied zıt anlamlı tuzaklardır.

passage: The concept of a four-day working week has gained traction in several countries. Proponents argue that shorter weeks lead to higher productivity, better mental health and lower carbon emissions from commuting. A large trial in the United Kingdom found that most participating companies maintained their output while employees reported less stress. Critics, however, caution that the model may not suit every sector; hospitals and schools, for instance, cannot simply close for an extra day.
prompt: What is the main purpose of the passage?
options: To present the benefits of a four-day week alongside its limitations
To prove that every company should adopt a four-day week
To explain why hospitals are closed on Fridays
To describe the history of working hours in the UK
To argue that productivity always falls when hours are reduced
explanation: Metin önce savunucuların görüşlerini ve deney sonucunu, ardından eleştirileri veriyor: dengeli bir sunum. 'Prove' ve 'always' gibi kesin ifadeler metinde desteklenmiyor.

passage: The concept of a four-day working week has gained traction in several countries. Proponents argue that shorter weeks lead to higher productivity, better mental health and lower carbon emissions from commuting. A large trial in the United Kingdom found that most participating companies maintained their output while employees reported less stress. Critics, however, caution that the model may not suit every sector; hospitals and schools, for instance, cannot simply close for an extra day.
prompt: It can be inferred from the passage that the UK trial ----.
options: did not lead to a significant loss of output for most companies
was cancelled because employees felt stressed
showed that critics were completely right
explanation: 'Most participating companies maintained their output' = çoğu şirket üretimini korudu, yani önemli bir kayıp yaşanmadı. Diğer şıklar metinle çelişiyor.

prompt:
Emma: I've been offered a job in Berlin, but I don't speak any German.
Leo: ----
Emma: That's true. Most of my colleagues would speak English anyway.
options: Well, a lot of international companies there work in English.
You should never accept a job abroad.
Berlin is the capital of Germany, isn't it?
I have never been to Berlin myself.
German is a very difficult language to learn.
explanation: Emma'nın cevabı ('That's true... English anyway') Leo'nun İngilizcenin iş dili olduğunu söylediğini gösterir. E şıkkı endişeyi artırır ve 'That's true' ile desteklenemez.

prompt:
Doctor: Your test results look fine, but you seem quite tired.
Patient: ----
Doctor: Then try to switch off your phone an hour before bed.
options: I've been having trouble sleeping; I usually check messages until midnight.
I feel great, I sleep nine hours every night.
Can I get a copy of my test results?
My sister is also a doctor.
explanation: Doktorun tavsiyesi (telefonu yatmadan önce kapat) hastanın uyku ve telefon kullanımıyla ilgili bir sorun anlattığını gösterir.

prompt: Plastic waste is one of the most serious environmental problems of our time. Every year, millions of tonnes of plastic end up in the oceans, harming marine life. ----. As a result, several countries have banned single-use plastic bags and straws.
options: Many sea animals mistake small plastic pieces for food and die
Plastic was invented at the beginning of the twentieth century
Some people prefer paper bags because they look nicer
Oceans cover more than seventy percent of the Earth's surface
Recycling centres are usually closed at weekends
explanation: Boşluk, deniz canlılarına verilen zararı açıklamalı ve 'As a result... banned' sonucuna zemin hazırlamalı. Diğer şıklar konu dışı bilgiler veriyor.

prompt: Learning a second language changes the brain in measurable ways. ----. For example, bilingual people often perform better on tasks that require switching attention between different activities. Some studies even suggest that speaking two languages may delay the onset of dementia.
options: Research shows that it strengthens areas linked to attention and memory
Many schools in Europe teach English from primary level
Some languages have more than twenty vowel sounds
It is easier to learn a language as a child than as an adult
Translators usually work with at least three languages
explanation: Boşluktan sonra gelen 'For example' dikkat değiştirme becerisinden bahsediyor; boşluk bu örneği kapsayan genel bir iddia olmalı: dikkat ve hafıza bölgelerinin güçlenmesi.

prompt: (I) Coffee is one of the most traded commodities in the world. (II) It is grown in more than seventy countries, mainly in tropical regions. (III) Brazil alone produces about a third of the global supply. (IV) Tea, on the other hand, originated in China thousands of years ago. (V) Changes in weather in coffee-growing areas can therefore affect prices worldwide.
explanation: Paragraf kahve üretimi ve ticaretini anlatıyor. IV. cümle çayın kökenine geçerek akışı bozuyor; V. cümle 'therefore' ile III'e bağlanıyor.

prompt: (I) Remote work has transformed the daily lives of millions of employees. (II) Without long commutes, many workers report having more time for family and exercise. (III) The first computer mouse was made of wood. (IV) At the same time, some people feel isolated and miss informal chats with colleagues. (V) Companies are therefore experimenting with hybrid models that combine home and office work.
explanation: Paragraf uzaktan çalışmanın etkilerini tartışıyor. III. cümle bilgisayar faresinin tarihine dair ilgisiz bir bilgi.

prompt: The lecturer gave a ---- overview of the topic, covering its history, current debates and future directions in just twenty minutes.
explanation: Tarihi, güncel tartışmaları ve geleceği kapsayan bir özet 'comprehensive' (kapsamlı) olur. Superficial (yüzeysel) 'covering its history, current debates...' ile çelişir.

prompt: Hardly ---- the lecture started when the fire alarm went off.
explanation: 'Hardly ... when' kalıbı devrik past perfect ile kurulur: Hardly had the lecture started when... (ders yeni başlamıştı ki...).

passage: Coral reefs cover less than one percent of the ocean floor, yet they support about a quarter of all marine species. Rising sea temperatures cause corals to expel the tiny algae living inside them, a process known as bleaching. Bleached corals are not dead, but they are under severe stress and may die if temperatures stay high for too long.
prompt: According to the passage, bleached corals ----.
options: can still survive if conditions improve in time
cover a quarter of the ocean floor
produce more algae than healthy corals
are found only in cold water
explanation: 'Bleached corals are not dead... may die if temperatures stay high for too long': sıcaklık zamanında düşerse hayatta kalabilirler. 'Always dead' metinle çelişiyor.

prompt: The findings of the study are ---- with earlier research, which also linked poor sleep to weaker memory.
explanation: 'Which also linked' (o da ilişkilendirmişti) önceki araştırmalarla uyumu gösterir: consistent with = ile tutarlı. Incompatible tam tersidir.

prompt: The students were asked ---- their mobile phones during the exam.
explanation: 'Ask someone (not) to do something' kalıbı: olumsuz emir 'not to + V1' ile verilir. Edilgen yapıda da aynı kalır: were asked not to use.

prompt: The medicine was withdrawn from the market ----.
options: after it was found to cause serious side effects in some patients
so that more patients could buy it
because it had been extremely effective
even though doctors had never prescribed it
as soon as it became the best-selling drug
explanation: Bir ilacın piyasadan çekilmesinin mantıklı nedeni ciddi yan etkilerdir. B ve C şıkları neden sonuç ilişkisini tersine çeviriyor.

prompt:
Can: Are you coming to the concert on Saturday?
Mert: ----
Can: Oh, that's a pity. Maybe next time then.
options: I'd love to, but I have to study for my exam.
Of course, I've already bought my ticket!
explanation: Can'ın 'That's a pity. Maybe next time' demesi Mert'in gelemeyeceğini gösterir. B şıkkı olumlu bir cevap olduğu için 'pity' ile uyuşmaz.

prompt: Bu çalışmanın amacı, sosyal medya kullanımının gençlerin uyku düzeni üzerindeki etkisini incelemektir.
options: The aim of this study is to examine the effect of social media use on young people's sleep patterns.
This study shows that young people who use social media sleep less.
The aim of social media is to change the sleep patterns of young people.
Young people's sleep patterns were examined by social media users in this study.
This study aims to reduce young people's use of social media before sleeping.
explanation: 'Amacı ... incelemektir' = The aim ... is to examine. B şıkkı bir sonuç iddia ediyor, E şıkkı amacı 'azaltmak' olarak değiştiriyor.

prompt:
Ayşe: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Can: ----. I have to visit my grandparents.
options: I'd love to, but I can't
That sounds great, see you there
I'm going to bring a cake
explanation: Can davete gelemeyeceğini söylüyor ve sebep veriyor. Kibarca reddetmenin kalıbı: "I'd love to, but I can't". Diğer seçenekler kabul ediyor.

prompt:
Mert: How often do you surf the Net?
Ece: ----
options: Twice a day, usually after school
explanation: "How often" sıklık sorar. Cevap sıklık bildirmeli: twice a day. "For two hours" süre, "because" sebep bildirir.

prompt: My brother always helps my mother in the kitchen. He ---- the table before dinner every evening.
explanation: "Set the table" sofrayı kurmak demek. Ev işleri ünitesinin kalıp ifadesi.

prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ---- the picnic.
explanation: Gelecekle ilgili koşul: If + şimdiki zaman, will + fiil.

prompt: Which of the following is TRUE according to the message?
options: Zeynep wants to meet at the library.
They will meet on Sunday morning.
explanation: Mesajda "Let's meet at the library on Saturday at 2 pm" yazıyor. Proje volkanlarla ilgili, bitmemiş, gün Cumartesi.
